name: Conservation Prediction
description: Can you predict γ+H? Given coupling weights, compute the conservation metric.

challenge.question: Given coupling weights [0.5, 0.3, 0.2, 0.8, 0.6], compute γ + H where γ is total coupling and H is Shannon entropy of the normalized weight distribution.

feedback.correct: Excellent! γ = 2.4, H ≈ 1.59 (5 equal-ish weights), so γ+H ≈ 3.99. Conservation is maintained.
feedback.incorrect: Step 1: γ = sum(weights) = 2.4. Step 2: Normalize weights to probabilities. Step 3: H = -Σ p·log₂(p). The entropy of 5 roughly equal weights is close to log₂(5) ≈ 2.32.
